details.description: Milk is considered as one of the most nutritious drink. Rich with health benefits, it is a powerhouse of nutrition and has all the vitamins, minerals, calcium to keep you healthy. One cup of milk a day keeps you healthy and protects your body from many ailments.

Godrej Jersey Homogenised Fresh Toned Milk is fresh and pure toned milk, carefully processed to deliver a smooth and consistent texture. Made from quality milk, it is a convenient everyday choice for tea, coffee, breakfast cereals, desserts and cooking. With 3.0 g of protein per 100 ml, it provides a source of protein as part of a balanced diet. The milk contains no added sugar and is fortified with Vitamins A and D2. It has 3.0% fat and 8.5% SNF, offering a balanced combination of taste and nutrition for everyday consumption. The product contains milk and is suitable for a variety of daily uses.

details.description: Fresh paneer (cottage cheese) from Godrej Jersey, made from milk. A versatile ingredient for curries, tikkas, bhurji and snacks. Keep refrigerated.

Godrej Jersey Paneer is super soft, creamy and made to retain its texture without crumbling easily. Naturally rich in protein and calcium, this paneer is a nutritious addition to meals and can be used in curries, gravies, snacks, salads or enjoyed on its own. Made without preservatives and free from added chemicals, it offers a wholesome choice for your family. Its soft, creamy texture and quality ingredients make Godrej Jersey Paneer a versatile and delicious addition to everyday cooking and special meals alike.

Jersey cooking butter is acquired from curds or milk with no preservatives like salt, colouring, or flavouring agents. It is a concentrated form of milk fat, containing 1% curd, 80% milk fat, and 19% moisture. It is especially rich in fat and fat-soluble vitamins K, E, A, and D.
